description: Roboto Studio dependency policy. Repos extend this LAST so it wins over vendor presets: extends: [..., "local>robotostudio/.github"].

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Dependabot owns CVEs. Off here so both bots don't file for the same one.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly lockfile refresh. This is what stops PRs rotting into conflicts.

packageRules.description: Everything non-major in one PR, merged by the bot on green CI. `bump` and `lockfileUpdate` are listed because rangeStrategy:bump produces them.
Actions move together, separately from npm.
Majors raise their own PR for review. Never auto-merged.
Framework core moves in lockstep and gets human eyes. minimumReleaseAge is re-asserted because sanity-io's min-age-exceptions preset zeroes it for these exact packages.
CMS client libraries: one PR, human eyes. No-op in repos without them.
